reason: Req 1 requires `is_safe_url` to reject whitespace control chars, but `strip_control_chars(url)` runs first and removes \t, \n, \r and other control bytes, so the later `isspace()` check never sees them. A URL with embedded control bytes (e.g. `https://ex\nample.org`) passes validation and is emitted by `sanitize_markdown_link` in cleaned form. The added tests cover only the javascript: and plain https cases, so this gap is untested. The scheme allowlist and javascript:/data: rejection look correct.
